column2: egui is an immediate mode GUI library written in Rust. egui runs natively on {os}, and on the web it is compiled to WebAssembly and rendered with WebGL or WebGPU.

column2: Everything you see is rendered as textured triangles. There is no DOM, HTML, JS or CSS. Just Rust.
column3: كل ما تراه يُصيَّر كمثلثات مكسوّة بأنسجة. لا يوجد DOM ولا HTML ولا JS ولا CSS. فقط Rust.
